high_level_description: This image captures the iconic Big Ben clock tower and the Houses of Parliament in London, England, during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm golden hues illuminating the structures. The sky is a gradient of blue, transitioning from a lighter shade at the horizon to a deeper blue higher up, suggesting the time of day is either early morning or late evening. The Big Ben clock tower stands prominently in the center of the image, with its intricate Gothic Revival architecture clearly visible.
